messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑look list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a weekday or is observed on a weekday, giving you at least two consecutive days off plus the weekend.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Observed (if different) | Long‑weekend span |
|---------|---------|--------------------------|-------------------|
| **Dec 31 2022 – Jan 2 2023** | New Year’s Day | Observed on Monday Jan 2 (holiday fell on Sunday) | 3‑day break (Sat Dec 31 – Mon Jan 2) |
| **Feb 20 2023 – Feb 22 2023** | Family Day (all provinces that observe it) | — | 3‑day break (Mon Feb 20 – Wed Feb 22) |
| **Apr 7 2023 – Apr 9 2023** | Good Friday | — | 3‑day break (Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9) |
| **May 22 2023 – May 24 2023** | Victoria Day | — | 3‑day break (Mon May 22 – Wed May 24) |
| **Jul 1 2023 – Jul 3 2023** | Canada Day | Observed on Monday Jul 3 (holiday fell on Saturday) | 3‑day break (Sat Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3) |
| **Sep 4 2023 – Sep 6 2023** | Labour Day | — | 3‑day break (Mon Sep 4 – Wed Sep 6) |
| **Oct 9 2023 – Oct 11 2023** | Thanksgiving | — | 3‑day break (Mon Oct 9 – Wed Oct 11) |
| **Nov 11 2023 – Nov 13 2023** | Remembrance Day | Observed on Monday Nov 13 (holiday fell on Saturday) | 3‑day break (Sat Nov 11 – Mon Nov 13) |
| **Dec 25 2023 – Dec 27 2023** | Christmas Day | — | 3‑day break (Mon Dec 25 – Wed Dec 27) |

> **Note:**  
> • Boxing Day (Dec 26 2023) is a Tuesday, so it does **not** create a long weekend.  
> • Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario on Mar 17 2023) that can also give a short long weekend, but the table above lists the nationwide statutory holidays that produced long weekends across Canada in 2023.  

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app!
